info.description: Atrium Therapeutics, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on delivering ribonucleic acid (RNA) therapeutics to the heart to transform the care for people living with cardiomyopathies. The company's development stage product candidates include ATR 1072, a siRNA-based therapy targeting PRKAG2 for the treatment of PRKAG2 syndrome; and ATR 1086, a siRNA-based therapy targeting PLN for the treatment of PLN cardiomyopathy. It also focuses on pipeline to treat a range of genetic and cardiac diseases. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.
